# Setup
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(pals)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggprism)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(AUCell)
library("org.Hs.eg.db")

root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"

data.dir <- paste0(root.dir, 'ExternalData/')

processed.data.dir <- paste0(root.dir, 'ProcessedData/')

set.seed(123)
```

# Herring 2022

# PMI correlation by sample
```{r}
# all Herring 2022 data no filter
seurat.obj.merged <- readRDS(paste0(data.dir, 'Herring_2022/', 'processed/', 'all.sampled.merged.downsampled.seurat.obj.RDS'))

herring.2022 <- subset(seurat.obj.merged, subset = (is.sample.organoid_ == FALSE))
print(dim(herring.2022))

# read in Herring 2022 metadata from supplemental table
herring.2022.supp.metadata <- readxl::read_excel(paste0(data.dir, 'Herring_2022/', 'TableS1_1-s2.0-S0092867422012582-mmc1.xlsx'), sheet = "sample.metadata.JP.modified")
herring.2022.sample.metadata <- herring.2022.supp.metadata %>% dplyr::select(c(`snRNA-seq library ID`, PMI, `Age (years)`, Stage, `Stage category`, Sex, Race, `Oxygen/No Oxygen`, Individual, `Cause of Death`, `Brain Regions*`)) 
herring.2022.sample.metadata$Stage <- as.factor(herring.2022.sample.metadata$Stage)
herring.2022.sample.metadata$Sex <- as.factor(herring.2022.sample.metadata$Sex)
herring.2022.sample.metadata$Race <- as.factor(herring.2022.sample.metadata$Race)
print(dim(herring.2022.sample.metadata))
```



# Process data
```{r}
# add module score for gene signatures
herring.2022 <- add.module.score(herring.2022, gene.signatures)
herring.2022 <- add.module.score(herring.2022, gene.signatures.gsea)

# aggregate analysis by sample/individual
# covariates with "_" were generated for all cells (including filtered out ones) on the sample level
herring.2022.metadata <- herring.2022@meta.data # has metadata but only for cells not filtered out. merge with sample level metadata
herring.2022.metadata$PMI_ <- as.numeric(as.character(herring.2022.metadata$PMI_))
herring.2022.metadata$library.id_ <- as.character(herring.2022.metadata$library.id_)

herring.2022.metadata <- herring.2022.metadata %>% left_join(herring.2022.sample.metadata, by=c('library.id_'='snRNA-seq library ID', 'PMI_'='PMI'))


# PMI regression with all covariates
# covariate.y is from the sample-level metadata (supplemental table) rather than the published cell-level metadata
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample <- herring.2022.metadata %>% 
  group_by(library.id_, geo.sample.id_, PMI_, `Age (years)`, Stage, `Stage category`, Sex.y, Race.y, `Oxygen/No Oxygen`, `Cause of Death`, `Brain Regions*`) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(
            mean.percent.mt = mean(percent.mt),
            mean.postmortem.glial = mean(postmortem.glial),
            mean.postmortem.score = mean(postmortem.signature),
            mean.postmortem.sensitive = mean(postmortem.sensitive),
            mean.heat.shock = mean(heat.shock.signature),
            mean.apoptosis = mean(apoptosis.signature),
            mean.necrosis = mean(necrosis.signature),
            mean.hypoxia = mean(hypoxia.signature))
print(dim(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample))


# renaming variables for convenience
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample <- herring.2022.metadata.by.sample %>% dplyr::rename(library.id=library.id_) 
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample <- herring.2022.metadata.by.sample %>% dplyr::rename(PMI=PMI_)
```

# Regression models
```{r}
run_pmi_model <- function(data, 
                          predictors, 
                          response = "PMI", 
                          results.dir = NULL, 
                          save.figures = FALSE, 
                          fig.name = "PMI_vs_PMI.prediction.pdf",
                          save.model.summary = FALSE,
                          summary.name = "PMI_model_summary.txt") {
  # ---- Build model formula ----
  formula_str <- paste(response, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
  model_formula <- as.formula(formula_str)
  
  # ---- Fit linear model ----
  model <- lm(model_formula, data = data)
  model_summary <- summary(model)
  print(model_summary)
  
  # ---- Extract key metrics ----
  r.sq <- model_summary$r.squared
  adj.r.sq <- model_summary$adj.r.squared
  f.pval <- pf(model_summary$fstatistic[1],
               model_summary$fstatistic[2],
               model_summary$fstatistic[3],
               lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  # ---- Optionally save model summary ----
  if (save.model.summary && !is.null(results.dir)) {
    sink(file.path(results.dir, summary.name))
    print(model_summary)
    cat("\n--- Extracted metrics ---\n")
    cat("R²:", r.sq, "\n")
    cat("Adjusted R²:", adj.r.sq, "\n")
    cat("Model p-value:", f.pval, "\n")
    sink()
  }
  
  # ---- Predictions ----
  data$adjusted.y <- predict(model, newdata = data)
  
  # ---- Correlation ----
  cor.res <- cor.test(data[[response]], data$adjusted.y, method = correlation.method.use)
  cor.label <- paste0("Spearman rho = ", round(cor.res$estimate, 2),
                      "\n p = ", formatC(cor.res$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2))
  
  # ---- Plot ----
  p <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = response, y = "adjusted.y")) + 
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + 
    xlab("Postmortem interval (hours)") +
    ylab("Postmortem interval (hours)\nmodel predicted") +
    geom_smooth(method='lm') +
    annotate("text", x=-Inf, y=Inf, hjust=-0.1, vjust=1.5, label=cor.label, size=6)
  
  # ---- Save figure ----
  if (save.figures && !is.null(results.dir)) {
    pdf(file.path(results.dir, fig.name), width=10, height=8)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  }
  
  return(list(
    model = model,
    model_summary = model_summary,
    R2 = r.sq,
    adj_R2 = adj.r.sq,
    model_pval = f.pval,
    cor.res = cor.res,
    plot = p
  ))
}

models.dir <- paste0(results.dir, 'Herring_2022/', 'models/')
metadata.vars <- c("Sex.y", "Race.y", "`Age (years)`", "`Oxygen/No Oxygen`")


# Figure 1
model <- lm(mean.postmortem.score ~ mean.percent.mt, data=herring.2022.metadata.by.sample)
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample$mean.postmortem.score.res <- residuals(model)
p <- ggplot(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample, aes(x = PMI, y = mean.postmortem.score.res)) + 
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + 
    xlab("Postmortem interval (hours)") +
    ylab("Postmortem enriched score (MT adjusted)") +
    geom_smooth(method='lm') +
    stat_cor(method = correlation.method.use, size = 7, cor.coef.name = "rho")
pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 1/", "herring2022_PMI_vs_postmortem_enriched_percent_mt_adjusted.pdf"), width = 10, height = 8)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

# Heat shock signature vs cause of death
```{r}
cod.abbreviations <- abbreviate(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample$`Cause of Death`)
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample$cod.label <- cod.abbreviations
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample$cod <- apply(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample, 1, function(row) 
  ifelse(row[["cod.label"]] %in% c("PHmd", "CoLVN"), 
         "Unclear", 
         ifelse(row[["Oxygen/No Oxygen"]] == "Oxygen", "Hypoxia", "Normoxia"))
)
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample$cod <- factor(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample$cod, levels = c("Normoxia", "Hypoxia", "Unclear"))


# Figure 1

# abbreviations table
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.df <- herring.2022.metadata.by.sample %>% data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cod.label, Cause.of.Death) %>% arrange(cod.label) %>% distinct()
colnames(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.df) <- c("Abbreviation", "Cause of Death")
write.table(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.df, paste0(root.dir, 'Figures/', 'Figure 1/', 'cause.of.death.abbreviations.tsv'), sep = "\t", quote = F)

set.seed(123)
p.heat.shock <- ggplot(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample, aes(cod, mean.heat.shock, label = cod.label)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(seed=1), alpha = 0.6) + 
  geom_text_repel(position = position_jitter(seed=1), size=4, color = "black") +
  xlab("Cause of death") +
  ylab("Hypoxia heat shock score") +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Normoxia", "Hypoxia")))

pdf(paste0(results.dir, 'Herring_2022/', 'cause.of.death_vs_heat.shock.score_all.pdf'), width=10, height = 6)
print(p.heat.shock)
dev.off()


# remove unclear causes of death
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.filter <- herring.2022.metadata.by.sample %>% filter(cod != "Unclear")

set.seed(123)
p.heat.shock <- ggplot(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.filter, aes(cod, mean.heat.shock, label = cod.label)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(seed=1), alpha = 0.6) + 
  geom_text_repel(position = position_jitter(seed=1), size=4, color = "black") +
  xlab("Cause of death") +
  ylab("Hypoxia heat shock score") +
  ylim(c(-0.2, 1.2))

wt_result <- wilcox.test(mean.heat.shock ~ cod, data = herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.filter)
p_val <- format.pval(wt_result$p.value, digits = 2)
p_label <- paste0("p = ", p_val)

p <- p.heat.shock + 
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("Normoxia", "Hypoxia")),
    annotations = p_label,
    y_position = max(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.filter$mean.heat.shock) + 0.05,
    tip_length = 0.03,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 0.5,     
    textsize = 6    
  )

pdf(paste0(root.dir, 'Figures/', 'Figure 1/', 'herring2022_cause_of_death_vs_hypoxia_heat_shock.pdf'), width=10, height = 8)
print(p)
dev.off()
```




# PMI correlation by sample and cell type
```{r}
# by cell type
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype <- herring.2022.metadata %>%
  group_by(library.id_, PMI_, `Age (years)`, Stage, `Stage category`, Sex.y, Race.y, `Oxygen/No Oxygen`, `Brain Regions*`, annotation_l1) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
            mean.percent.mt = mean(percent.mt),
            mean.postmortem.score = mean(postmortem.signature),
            mean.heat.shock = mean(heat.shock.signature),
            mean.postmortem.glial = mean(postmortem.glial),
            mean.postmortem.sensitive = mean(postmortem.sensitive),
            mean.immune.signature = mean(immune.factor),
            mean.vascular.signature = mean(vascular.factor),
            mean.neuron.signature = mean(neurons.factor),
            mean.glial.signature= mean(glial.factor),
            mean.malignant.signature = mean(malignant.factor)) %>%
  ungroup()

herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype <- herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype %>% dplyr::rename(library.id=library.id_)
herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype <- herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype %>% dplyr::rename(PMI=PMI_)

herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype$annotation_l1 <- sapply(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype$annotation_l1, function(x) ifelse(x %in% c("Low.quality", "Poor.Quality"), "Low.quality", x))
#herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype.filter <- herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype %>% filter(annotation_l1 %ni% c("Low.quality", "Poor.Quality"))


metadata.vars <- c("Sex.y", "Race.y", "`Age (years)`", "`Oxygen/No Oxygen`")
postmortem.signatures <- c("mean.heat.shock", "mean.postmortem.sensitive", "mean.percent.mt", "mean.postmortem.score")


# postmortem score
res <- run_pmi_model(
  data = herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype,
  predictors = c(postmortem.signatures,
                 "annotation_l1"),
  results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
  save.figures = TRUE,
  fig.name = "PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_w.annotaiton_l1_no.metadata.pdf",
  save.model.summary = TRUE,
  summary.name = "PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_w.annotaiton_l1_no.metadata.txt"
)

# postmortem score + metadata
res <- run_pmi_model(
  data = herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype,
  predictors = c(postmortem.signatures,
                 "annotation_l1",
                  metadata.vars),
  results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
  save.figures = TRUE,
  fig.name = "PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_w.annotaiton_l1_w.metadata.pdf",
  save.model.summary = TRUE,
  summary.name = "PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_w.annotaiton_l1_w.metadata.txt"
)


for (celltype in unique(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype$annotation_l1)) {
  print(celltype)
  
  celltype.df <- filter(herring.2022.metadata.by.sample.celltype, annotation_l1 == celltype)
  
  
  # postmortem score
  predictors <- c("mean.postmortem.score", "mean.heat.shock",
                 "mean.postmortem.sensitive", "mean.percent.mt")
  
  if (celltype == "Glial") {
    
    res <- run_pmi_model(
      data = celltype.df,
      predictors = c(postmortem.signatures, "mean.postmortem.glial"),
      results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
      save.figures = TRUE,
      fig.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_postmortem.glial_no.metadata.pdf"),
      save.model.summary = TRUE,
      summary.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_postmortem.glial_no.metadata.txt")
    )
    
    res <- run_pmi_model(
      data = celltype.df,
      predictors = c(postmortem.signatures, "mean.postmortem.glial", metadata.vars),
      results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
      save.figures = TRUE,
      fig.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_postmortem.glial_w.metadata.pdf"),
      save.model.summary = TRUE,
      summary.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_postmortem.glial_w.metadata.txt")
    )
  }
  
  res <- run_pmi_model(
    data = celltype.df,
    predictors = postmortem.signatures,
    results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
    save.figures = TRUE,
    fig.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_no.metadata.pdf"),
    save.model.summary = TRUE,
    summary.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_no.metadata.txt")
  )
  
  
  # percent.mt and postmortem.score
  res <- run_pmi_model(
    data = celltype.df,
    predictors = c(postmortem.signatures, metadata.vars),
    results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
    save.figures = TRUE,
    fig.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_w.metadata.pdf"),
    save.model.summary = TRUE,
    summary.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_w.metadata.txt")
  )
}
```

# PMI correlation by sample and cell type
```{r}
# by sample and cell type
sample.celltype.df <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(individual, sample, region, diagnosis, sex, age, post.mortem.interval..hours., Capbatch, Seqbatch, RNA.Integrity.Number, annotation_l1) %>% 
  summarize(mean.postmortem.score = mean(postmortem.signature),
            mean.percent.mt = mean(percent.mt),
            mean.heat.shock = mean(heat.shock.signature),
            mean.postmortem.glial = mean(postmortem.glial),
            mean.postmortem.sensitive = mean(postmortem.sensitive)) %>%
  ungroup()
sample.celltype.df$PMI <- sample.celltype.df$post.mortem.interval..hours.
sample.celltype.df <- sample.celltype.df %>% filter(diagnosis == "Control")



metadata.vars <-  c("sex", "region", "age")
postmortem.signatures <- c("mean.heat.shock", "mean.postmortem.sensitive", "mean.percent.mt", "mean.postmortem.score")


# all variables, no metadata
res <- run_pmi_model(
  data = sample.celltype.df,
  predictors = c(postmortem.signatures, 
                 "annotation_l1"),
  results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
  save.figures = TRUE,
  fig.name = "PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_w.annotation.l1_no.metadata.pdf",
  save.model.summary = TRUE,
  summary.name = "PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_w.annotation.l1_no.metadata.txt"
)


# all variables, with metadata
res <- run_pmi_model(
  data = sample.celltype.df,
  predictors = c(postmortem.signatures, 
                 "annotation_l1",
                 metadata.vars),
  results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
  save.figures = TRUE,
  fig.name = "PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_w.annotation.l1_w.metadata.pdf",
  save.model.summary = TRUE,
  summary.name = "PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_w.annotation.l1_w.metadata.txt"
)



for (celltype in unique(sample.celltype.df$annotation_l1)) {
  print(celltype)
  
  celltype.df <- filter(sample.celltype.df, annotation_l1 == celltype)
  
  # all variables
  predictors <- postmortem.signatures
  if (celltype == "Glial") {
    res <- run_pmi_model(
      data = celltype.df,
      predictors = c(predictors, "mean.postmortem.glial"),
      results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
      save.figures = TRUE,
      fig.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_postmortem.glial_no.metadata.pdf"),
      save.model.summary = TRUE,
      summary.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_postmortem.glial_no.metadata.txt")
    )
  
    res <- run_pmi_model(
      data = celltype.df,
      predictors = c(predictors, "mean.postmortem.glial", metadata.vars),
      results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
      save.figures = TRUE,
      fig.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_postmortem.glial_w.metadata.pdf"),
      save.model.summary = TRUE,
      summary.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_postmortem.glial_w.metadata.txt")
    )
  }
 
  res <- run_pmi_model(
    data = celltype.df,
    predictors = predictors,
    results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
    save.figures = TRUE,
    fig.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_no.metadata.pdf"),
    save.model.summary = TRUE,
    summary.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_no.metadata.txt")
  )
  
  res <- run_pmi_model(
    data = celltype.df,
    predictors = c(predictors, metadata.vars),
    results.dir = paste0(models.dir, "by_celltype/"),
    save.figures = TRUE,
    fig.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_vs_PMI.prediction_all.postmortem.signatures_w.metadata.pdf"),
    save.model.summary = TRUE,
    summary.name = paste0(celltype, "_PMI_model_summary_all.postmortem.signatures_w.metadata.txt")
  )
}
```
